title: Tricky Situation
reviewNotes: Three branches and 20 checked positions from the complete six-piece diagram. Trapped-knight sacrifice Nc8+ Kd8 Ka5 Kxc8 Ka6 sets zugzwang; two bishop-sacrifice routes reach winning pawn endings. Immediate Ka6 draws. Captions and stable diagrams agree; transient king slides were not encoded as positions.
transcript: The white knight is completely trapped. If we try to defend it with the king, now after king to D6, black is threatening to remove the defense of the pawn and then pick up our white pawn. So, we have to play knight to B5. The pawn is still going to be lost and this is just going to be a draw. So, if we go back to the starting position, white has to try knight to C8 with a check. If the black king moves away, we are going to come in and trap the bishop. So, the black king has to go to D8 and now attack the white knight. And again, it seems like the knight has no way of getting out. All of these squares are defended by one of the black pieces. But, white is not a fool and he finds an incredible resource that actually wins the game by force. The brilliant king to A5. An incredible move that waits the right moment to start walking in with the white king. Of course, black picks up the knight. And now, only now, the king goes to A6. Why? Well, because this is a zugzwang. If you move the bishop, of course, I'm just going to take it and now the king is going to be forced out and we're going to be able to pick up the black pawn. But wait, the black king can just go out like this. Now, king to B7 traps the bishop and there is no way for the black king to come back to defend it. But, do not celebrate too soon. Black can try the very interesting bishop to A7, sacrificing the bishop on his own terms. Of course, we want to pick it up and now the king can come back to C8 and try to keep the white king at bay. But, unfortunately, after king to A8, the situation doesn't change. The black king has to move out. The white king is going to to in, win the black pawn, promote to a queen, and win the game.
